dialogue.notes: Paged dialogue box ($00:ED80): $D5=24 tiles (192px) x $D7=3 lines per {page} inside 28-tile (224px) window border (tx=2..29).

prologue_crawl.notes: Act 2 Kublai ocean crawl ($09:9C4A): 1x VWF per $FF string on full 256px BG3 with left/right margins (~208px safe).

ending_crawl.notes: Epilogue crawl ($1D:A200..A57A): uses same 1x BG3 line renderer as prologue_crawl; <=21 JP chars, ~208px safe width.

system.notes: Shop, inn, save, and system messages ($1D:A800..B0AB): rendered in the standard 192px x 3-line dialogue window.

ui.notes: General UI labels ($1D:C2D1..D834); narrow sub-boxes (title_menu, battle_cmd, status_lv, status_slash, status_currency) have tighter limits below.

equip_name.notes: 2-column equip/shop item list inside 30-tile (240px) window (tx=1..30): ~12 printable tiles (96px) per column.

item_name.notes: 2-column consumable item/shop list inside 240px window: 96px (12 tiles) per column.

jutsu_name.notes: 2-column jutsu/spell list in menu and battle windows: <=96px (12 tiles) per column.

ougi_name.notes: Special attack names displayed in battle/tech lists ($1D:B8E9..B93D): <=96px per entry.

enemy_name.notes: Battle right enemy list shares 17-tile box (tx=14..30) minus cursor/margin -> 120px safe width; encounter banner has 192px.

location_banner.notes: 8x32 banner scaler ($0B:8F6C/$0B:901C): 8px per char, 32-char (256px) VRAM max, 30 chars (240px) hard cap (28 chars / 224px recommended); centered via Hook_0B8F90.

equip_desc.notes: Equipment descriptions ($1D:DC3E..E827) shown in 192px x 3-line description/dialogue window (max 29 JP chars / 3 lines).

item_desc.notes: Item descriptions ($1D:E828..ECCD) shown in 192px x 2-line description window.

jutsu_desc.notes: Jutsu descriptions & MP cost formatting ($1D:ECCE..F59E): 192px x 3 lines.

credits_overlay.notes: 8x32 chapter-card overlay ($1D:F59F..F7F7): conservative 12-char (96px) top-slot ceiling; see credits_overlay_top (96px / 12 chars) and credits_overlay_bottom (160px / 20 chars).

credits_overlay_top.notes: 8x32 chapter/role top line ($0B:8EE3 -> VRAM $0400..$057F): hard limit 12 chars at 8px/char = 96px.

credits_overlay_bottom.notes: 8x32 staff/name bottom line ($0B:8F06 -> VRAM $0580..$07FF): hard limit 20 chars at 8px/char = 160px.

party_name.notes: Default party member names ($30:A900 -> Hook_F4D9 -> $7E:A800): hardware 6 tiles x 8px = 48px max width.

title_menu.notes: Title Start/Continue box (1D_C7A3, 1D_C7A9): box width widened by 1 tile at $00:8095 (8->9) giving 6 clear interior tiles (48px) right of cursor.

battle_cmd.notes: Bottom-left 2x2 battle command box (1D_C427, 1D_C44C, 1D_C32C, 1D_C331): 5 tiles (40px) per option.

battle_msg.notes: Full-width bottom battle message box (tx=1..30, $D5=24 tiles printable).

battle_hud_name.notes: Top battle HUD & command box header party name: rendered from {name0..4} 48px slot.

status_lv.notes: Status box level label (1D_C395): 3 tiles (24px) before numeric level overwrites column 4.

status_slash.notes: Status HP/MP separator (1D_C3F3 / D7F4): 1 tile (8px) wide between current and max values.

status_currency.notes: Status currency unit label (1D_C411): 2 tiles (16px) left of amount.

fullscreen_card.notes: Centered full-screen intro cards drawn via $00:E76B/$00:E948 (1D_AD9D, 1D_ADB5); single-line parser skips {nl}.
